files.incidents/README.txt:
Service incidents, autumn.

incidents.txt holds one line per recorded incident.
policy.txt defines the three bands incidents are sorted into.
files.incidents/policy.txt:
Severity policy

Incidents are banded by the minutes of interrupted service.
Band A: fewer minutes than severity.band_low.
Band B: from severity.band_low up to, but not including, severity.band_high.
Band C: severity.band_high minutes or more.
The two values are kept in the operations configuration.
